{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module SearchIndex where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.STM.TVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_, void)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.IORef

-- Rate limiting state
data RateLimitState = RateLimitState
  { rlTokens :: !Int
  , rlLastRefill :: !UTCTime
  , rlMaxTokens :: !Int
  , rlRefillRate :: !Int  -- tokens per second
  }

-- Index entry with versioning
data IndexEntry = IndexEntry
  { ieContent :: !String
  , ieVersion :: !Int
  , ieTimestamp :: !UTCTime
  , ieOwner :: !String
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Pending update request
data UpdateRequest = UpdateRequest
  { urKey :: !String
  , urContent :: !String
  , urRequestor :: !String
  , urPriority :: !Int
  , urSubmitTime :: !UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

-- The search index service state
data SearchIndexService = SearchIndexService
  { sisIndex :: TVar (Map String IndexEntry)
  , sisRateLimit :: TVar (Map String RateLimitState)
  , sisPendingQueue :: TVar [UpdateRequest]
  , sisRetryCount :: TVar (Map String Int)
  , sisMaxRetries :: !Int
  , sisProcessingLock :: MVar ()
  }

newSearchIndexService :: IO SearchIndexService
newSearchIndexService = do
  idx <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  rl <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  pq <- newTVarIO []
  rc <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  lock <- newMVar ()
  return $ SearchIndexService idx rl pq rc 3 lock

-- Check rate limit for a user
checkRateLimit :: SearchIndexService -> String -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit sis user = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  atomically $ do
    limits <- readTVar (sisRateLimit sis)
    case Map.lookup user limits of
      Nothing -> do
        let newState = RateLimitState 9 now 10 2
        writeTVar (sisRateLimit sis) (Map.insert user newState limits)
        return True
      Just st -> do
        let elapsed = realToFrac (diffUTCTime now (rlLastRefill st)) :: Double
            refilled = min (rlMaxTokens st) (rlTokens st + floor (elapsed * fromIntegral (rlRefillRate st)))
        if refilled > 0
          then do
            let newState = st { rlTokens = refilled - 1, rlLastRefill = now }
            writeTVar (sisRateLimit sis) (Map.insert user newState limits)
            return True
          else return False

-- Submit an update request (enters the pending queue)
submitUpdate :: SearchIndexService -> String -> String -> String -> Int -> IO Bool
submitUpdate sis key content requestor priority = do
  allowed <- checkRateLimit sis requestor
  if not allowed
    then return False
    else do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      let req = UpdateRequest key content requestor priority now
      atomically $ modifyTVar' (sisPendingQueue sis) (++ [req])
      return True

-- Process pending queue - applies updates to the index
-- Uses the processing lock to ensure atomic batch processing
processPendingUpdates :: SearchIndexService -> IO ()
processPendingUpdates sis = do
  withMVar (sisProcessingLock sis) $ \_ -> do
    -- Atomically drain queue and apply all updates in one transaction
    atomically $ do
      q <- readTVar (sisPendingQueue sis)
      writeTVar (sisPendingQueue sis) []
      let sorted = sortByPriority q
      forM_ sorted $ \req -> applyUpdateSTM sis req

sortByPriority :: [UpdateRequest] -> [UpdateRequest]
sortByPriority = foldr insertSorted []
  where
    insertSorted x [] = [x]
    insertSorted x (y:ys)
      | urPriority x >= urPriority y = x : y : ys
      | otherwise = y : insertSorted x ys

-- Apply update atomically within the same STM transaction
-- No TOCTOU: read and write happen in the same atomic block
applyUpdateSTM :: SearchIndexService -> UpdateRequest -> STM ()
applyUpdateSTM sis req = do
  idx <- readTVar (sisIndex sis)
  let currentVersion = maybe 0 ieVersion (Map.lookup (urKey req) idx)
      -- Use a fixed timestamp placeholder; caller provides real time if needed
      newEntry = IndexEntry
        { ieContent = urContent req
        , ieVersion = currentVersion + 1
        , ieTimestamp = urSubmitTime req
        , ieOwner = urRequestor req
        }
  writeTVar (sisIndex sis) (Map.insert (urKey req) newEntry idx)

-- Retry logic for failed updates (network issues, etc.)
tryApplyUpdate :: SearchIndexService -> UpdateRequest -> IO Bool
tryApplyUpdate sis req = do
  -- Single atomic transaction: read + validate + write
  atomically $ do
    idx <- readTVar (sisIndex sis)
    let currentVersion = maybe 0 ieVersion (Map.lookup (urKey req) idx)
        newEntry = IndexEntry
          { ieContent = urContent req
          , ieVersion = currentVersion + 1
          , ieTimestamp = urSubmitTime req
          , ieOwner = urRequestor req
          }
    writeTVar (sisIndex sis) (Map.insert (urKey req) newEntry idx)
    return True

scheduleRetry :: SearchIndexService -> UpdateRequest -> IO ()
scheduleRetry sis req = do
  shouldRetry <- atomically $ do
    retries <- readTVar (sisRetryCount sis)
    let count = Map.findWithDefault 0 (urKey req) retries
    if count < sisMaxRetries sis
      then do
        writeTVar (sisRetryCount sis) (Map.insert (urKey req) (count + 1) retries)
        return True
      else return False
  when shouldRetry $ do
    threadDelay (100000)  -- 100ms backoff
    void $ tryApplyUpdate sis req

-- Query the index
queryIndex :: SearchIndexService -> String -> IO (Maybe IndexEntry)
queryIndex sis key = atomically $ do
  idx <- readTVar (sisIndex sis)
  return $ Map.lookup key idx

-- Pending queue is NOT observable from outside - no information leak
-- Only returns count for monitoring, not contents
pendingQueueSize :: SearchIndexService -> IO Int
pendingQueueSize sis = atomically $ do
  q <- readTVar (sisPendingQueue sis)
  return (length q)
